name: flow_reactor
label: Hydrothermal flow reactor
description: Extracts residence time, flow, quench and injection settings of the flow reactor.
system_prompt: Extract values from a scientific paper. Report only what the paper states.
intro: Extracts residence time, flow, quench and injection settings of the flow reactor. For every set (and sample) in the structure plan below, extract the values the paper reports. A value that holds for every set goes in ONE row with `set` ''; one that differs between sets goes in each set's row; one that differs between the samples of a set goes in each sample's row.

parameters.description: Time the reaction solution spends in the heated reactor.
Temperature of the cooling bath that quenches the reactor effluent.
Volume of sample solution injected into the flow of hot water.
Type and material of the flow reactor and how the sample is introduced.
